title: Chain Rule with Two Independent Parameters
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For z = exp(x) sin(y) with x = u^2 - v^2 and y = 2uv, find dz/du at (u, v) = (1, 1).

steps.title: Evaluate Intermediate Variables and Derivatives at (1, 1)
steps.mathExpression: x(1, 1) = 1 - 1 = 0, \; y(1, 1) = 2(1)(1) = 2; \quad \frac{\partial x}{\partial u} = 2u = 2, \; \frac{\partial y}{\partial u} = 2v = 2
steps.why: Finding values for chain rule tree.

steps.title: Compute Partial Derivatives of z
steps.mathExpression: \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = e^x \sin y \implies e^0 \sin 2 = \sin 2; \quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = e^x \cos y \implies e^0 \cos 2 = \cos 2
